source_documents.title: Molecular Engineering of High-Performance Aggregation-Induced Emission Photosensitizers to Boost Cancer Theranostics Mediated by Acid-Triggered Nucleus-Targeted Nanovectors

reference_evidence_units.quote: showed high D−A strength and extended π-conjugation with varying degrees.
reference_evidence_units.subject: Four named photosensitizers including TPE-TTMN-OMe
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Molecular design, Scheme 1A; donor-acceptor substitution series.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The authors assign increasing donor-acceptor strength and ICT as the design basis for red-shifted spectra across TTMN, TPE-TTMN, TPE-TTMN-OMe and TPE-TTMN-TPA.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Series design interpretation, not measured target-specific charge-transfer kinetics.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the suﬃcient rotations could consume exciton energy upon photoexcitation, thus allowing weak or no emission when dissolved in solution.
reference_evidence_units.subject: Four photosensitizers including TPE-TTMN-OMe
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Dissolved molecules contrasted with twisted aggregated conformations.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The authors invoke freely rotating groups for solution deactivation and twisted TPE/TPA groups to prevent close pi stacking on aggregation.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Explicit source interpretation supports a bounded RIM account; no target torsional barrier or viscosity control in this passage.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the maximum emissions peaked at 662, 656, 667, and 685 nm, respectively
reference_evidence_units.subject: Ordered series TTMN, TPE-TTMN, TPE-TTMN-OMe, TPE-TTMN-TPA
reference_evidence_units.statement: OMe is third: its solution emission maximum is 667 nm. All four solutions are faintly emissive.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The maximum quantum yield 0.32% is a series upper bound, not an OMe-specific value.

reference_evidence_units.quote: their emission maxima were respectively red-shifted to 664, 670, 685, and 712 nm in aggregates
reference_evidence_units.subject: Ordered four-member series; third member TPE-TTMN-OMe
reference_evidence_units.statement: OMe has an aggregate maximum of 685 nm and approximately 129-fold peak-intensity enhancement; the other enhancements are 12, 104 and 41 in series order.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Peak intensity is not quantum yield. The 712 nm aggregate peak belongs to TPA, not OMe.

reference_evidence_units.quote: in the solid state peaked at 691, 694, 722, and 770 nm, respectively
reference_evidence_units.subject: Four photosensitizers; third member TPE-TTMN-OMe
reference_evidence_units.statement: The solid-state OMe emission maximum is 722 nm.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Quantum yields 1.4-26.2% and lifetimes 5.94-7.6 ns are ranges; absent SI Table S1 prevents assigning endpoints to OMe.

reference_evidence_units.quote: TPE-TTMN, TPE-TTMN-OMe, and TPE-TTMN-TPA even exceeded Rose Bengal
reference_evidence_units.subject: Three AIEgens including OMe; Rose Bengal control
reference_evidence_units.conditions: DCFH ROS indicator; 0.2 micromolar AIEgen, white light 22.1 mW cm^-2, Figure 1F.
reference_evidence_units.statement: OMe exceeds the Rose Bengal response; DCFH alone is nearly nonemissive and TPA has the largest response.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Indirect ROS assay. Approximately 600-fold response and Type I species discrimination belong to TPA, not OMe.

reference_evidence_units.subject: TPE-TTMN-OMe
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Main-text account of singlet-triplet gaps; calculations referred to SI.
reference_evidence_units.statement: A singlet-triplet gap of 0.011 eV is reported for OMe; small gaps rationalize favorable ISC and ROS production.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Computed gap reported in main; underlying SI not inspected. No phosphorescence assignment.

reference_evidence_units.subject: TPE-TTMN-TPA nanocarrier formulation
reference_evidence_units.conditions: SA-TAT-PEG-PLA/PEG-PLA coassembly and nanoprecipitation for biological studies.
reference_evidence_units.statement: T4-NPs contain TPE-TTMN-TPA. Subsequent acid-triggered delivery, nuclear localization and tumor results are not OMe experiments.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Comparator identity boundary; carrier confinement and acid response are not OMe evidence.

reference_mechanisms.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Explicit series rotational-deactivation interpretation and target-included aggregation response support RIM provisionally, not merely the AIE name.

reference_mechanisms.label: ICT_TICT_CT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Retain the donor-acceptor/ICT interpretation without claiming TICT geometry.

reference_mechanisms.label: TRIPLET_METAL_ENERGY_TRANSFER
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Reported small singlet-triplet gap and ROS assay support the authors' ISC/photosensitization interpretation, not phosphorescent emission.

mechanism_decisions.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Explicit series rotational-deactivation interpretation and target-included aggregation response support RIM provisionally, not merely the AIE name.

mechanism_decisions.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific external packing or matrix confinement mechanism established in the extracted evidence.

mechanism_decisions.label: HOST_GUEST_INTERACTION
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific binding of a guest, solvent or analyte that alters emission established.

mechanism_decisions.label: ICT_TICT_CT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Retain the donor-acceptor/ICT interpretation without claiming TICT geometry.

mechanism_decisions.label: ESIPT_PT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No excited-state proton-transfer pathway established; hydrogen bonding or an OH substituent alone is insufficient.

mechanism_decisions.label: PET_ET
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No distinct photoinduced electron-transfer quenching or turn-on established; CT-state character is not by itself a separate PET process.

mechanism_decisions.label: AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific aggregate exciton, excimer or exciplex emission established; aggregation alone does not establish this family.

mechanism_decisions.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No separate radiative-rate or bright/dark-state balance mechanism established in the extracted evidence.

mechanism_decisions.label: TRIPLET_METAL_ENERGY_TRANSFER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Reported small singlet-triplet gap and ROS assay support the authors' ISC/photosensitization interpretation, not phosphorescent emission.

mechanism_decisions.label: RACI_CI_ACCESS
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No conical-intersection-mediated nonradiative pathway established for this target in the extracted evidence.

mechanism_decisions.label: SOKR_ANTI_KASHA
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No higher-excited-state emission established in the extracted evidence.
